products.name: AirGPT
products.blurb: Chat on this laptop. Settings, pairing, apps hub. Thin client of OpenVault for keys and Cortex for brains.

products.name: Space
products.blurb: Hit Space on a file. Quick Look for Windows. Preview, convert, optional AI over the file.

products.name: Cortex
products.blurb: The crew behind the laptop apps and Suite. Vanguard watches, Cortex decides, Closer acts. Not an inference server.

products.name: Constructor
products.blurb: Netie-native constructor. Sketch a graph. Cortex ranks three plays. Ghost mode writes nothing. Not n8n.

products.name: Suite
products.blurb: Company room: Vanguard watches, Cortex decides, Closer acts. Same crew as the laptop apps, built for a team.

products.name: OpenHBM
products.blurb: Open-source JEDEC JESD270-4A HBM4 subsystem plus RISC-V-native LPU. The RISC-V of memory and AI accelerators.

products.name: OpenVault
products.blurb: Public repo: NVME Sentinel Fusion with hardware monitoring and cache boosting middleware. Estate role: custody and routing (keys, leave-machine gate). Do not mix the two sentences in one claim without saying so.

products.name: OpenForge
products.blurb: PDF to schematic to SPICE to ngspice forge. Training data for analog IC design.

products.name: Cassandra
products.blurb: Daily multi-agent AI/semiconductor research. Crash Risk Score plus a written thesis. Not an auto-trader.

products.name: Vertex
products.blurb: Industrial AI manufacturing framework: quality control and predictive maintenance models for the factory edge.

products.name: AnalogCrawler
products.blurb: ACID: public analog/mixed-signal IC knowledge from manufacturer docs, patents, and open repos. Respect robots.txt.

products.name: CI-Doctor
products.blurb: Open-source CI doctor. Proof surface for hire documentation and engineering offers.

products.name: AIM
products.blurb: AI professional twin. LinkedIn-alternative thesis. Intake page exists; GitHub repo is empty as of 2026-08-25.

products.name: Talkie
products.blurb: Coming soon: child-safe AI companion plushie. Waitlist only. Not shipped.

products.name: Pointer
products.blurb: See the screen, click with a person in the loop. Not a second orchestrator. Public GitHub repo not in the org list as of 2026-08-25.

products.name: DMS / Spaces
products.blurb: ChatGPT for a company's spreadsheets and databases: every answer carries its rows. The engine is Cortex. Do not claim the Space ACL holds until that gate is wired.

news_seeds.headline: HBM is the bottleneck everyone is paying NVIDIA tax for. We published an open HBM4 controller.
Most 'AI employees' are a chat box on someone else's GPU. Cortex is a crew on your machine.
People keep cloning n8n and calling it an agent company. Constructor is a skin. Cortex is the engine.
